name: Emergent Industrial Solutions Limited
about: Emergent Industrial Solutions Limited primarily engages in trading activities of coal, coke, manganese ore, and other metal products in India. It offers raw materials and consumables, including metallic, non-ferrous metals, coal and coke, ferro alloy, ores, and plastic and polymers; agricultural commodities, including oilseeds and pulses, and edible and non-edible oils; and green energy products for solar energy and hydrogen gas, and energy storage. The company also supplies steel and steel products, such as billets and blooms, sabs, hot and cold rolled coils, galvanized coils and sheets, hot rolled sheets, special and alloy steel, wire rods and drawn wires, deformed bars, pipes and tubes, pre-painted coils and sheets, structurals, electrical steel coils/sheets, and other coated coils and sheets. In addition, it is involved in the provision of education services. The company was formerly known as Emergent Global Edu and Services Limited and changed its name to Emergent Industrial Solutions Limited in April 2020. Emergent Industrial Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in New Delhi, India.
